The existing XD JDBC and Kafka modules have no XD-specific business logic requiring modification beyond refactoring to s-c-s interfaces, so no functional changes are needed for migrated modules.

Hadoop shell command support will only cover core HDFS operations (list files, read content, create/delete directories/files, upload/download files) with no support for advanced Hadoop ecosystem commands required.
SpEL-based message binding will support standard message headers and bean property access for payloads, with no requirement for custom SpEL functions or expression extensions.

Implement core HDFS shell commands (ls, cat, mkdir, rm, put, get) using Spring Shell, integrate with the HDFS client, and add input validation and error handling for all commands.

activities.activity_name: Composed Job Orchestration REST API Implementation
